test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘T + W’ means ‘T is the father of W’

‘T – W’ means ‘T is the wife of W’

‘T × W’ means ‘T is the brother of W’

‘T ÷ W’ means ‘T is the daughter of W’.

What does ‘S + T ÷ U’ mean?

options.text: S is the brother of U
S is the husband of U
S is the son of U
S is the uncle of U

solution:
Family Chart: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cd8ae3409a7e80e7adb6a6adafb5ca1703115230729aa5a03a081d033c62e82.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ÷
 ×
 
 

 Meaning
 Father 
 Wife 
 Daughter 
 Brother 
 
 

 

Given: S + T ÷ U

It means: S is the father of T and T is the daughter of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6fcf04aa8b55b08194fd877882bf916bddee80284a3d91adb96f3d6b4c136ea.png] 

So, S is the husband of U.

Hence, the correct answer is "**S is the husband of U**".
